verdict.rationale: Zep documents self-hosted 'Your VPC' deployment (zep-docs-17) and its underlying Graphiti framework explicitly supports building/querying a Context Graph 'locally' as an embeddable library (zep-docs-15, zep-docs-43, zep-gh-1/2/3), suggesting a path to local operation without the managed cloud service. However, there's no evidence of Zep itself running fully embedded in-process (it's a server/API product requiring deployment), nor any documentation of configuring it against local LLMs/embedding models instead of hosted providers. missing for 10: explicit in-process/embedded mode for Zep proper, documented local-model configuration, and confirmation that VPC/self-host mode has zero calls to external LLM APIs.
